configurator.title: Configure your product

configurator.fixtureMode: Sample mode: data from the contract's sample cases, no real prices.

help.label: Help
help.material: Materials are grouped by board type. Options and size limits adapt to the material, e.g. edge polishing is only available for acrylic glass.
help.width: Final size after cutting in millimetres, without bleed. Example: 600 for a sign 60 cm wide.
help.height: Final size after cutting in millimetres, without bleed. Example: 400 for a sign 40 cm high.
help.formatGroup: Choose a standard size, e.g. DIN A1, or enter width and height freely.
help.motifs: How many different designs (print files) there are. Example: 3 designs × 10 pieces = 30 signs.
help.motifsSplit: How many designs the total quantity is split into. Example: 1,000 labels in 4 versions.
help.perMotif: Quantity per design. Example: 10 pieces per design with 3 designs gives 30 signs.
help.totalQuantity: Total quantity across all designs. Example: 1,000 labels, however many versions.
help.reference: Your order or cost centre reference for this item. It appears on the delivery note and invoice, e.g. “Branch North / CC 4711”.
help.delivery: When the goods reach you. The date applies to orders and print files received before the cut-off time, e.g. ordered today by 11:30 with standard = delivery in 5 working days.
help.option: Choose a finish. The price is recalculated immediately, e.g. matt laminate instead of no finish.
help.area: The total area (width × height × quantity) is the basis for the material and area-based options such as laminate, e.g. 1,000 × 500 mm × 10 pieces = 5 m². Minimum areas or billing steps are included in the price automatically.

field.rotateHelp: Portrait ↔ landscape: swaps width and height, e.g. 600 × 400 → 400 × 600 mm.
